summary: Aarav expresses feeling overwhelmed and irritable, indicating high stress and low emotional regulation. He uses vivid language about heaviness and a sense of running without progress, showing self‑awareness but also negative self‑talk.

strengths.title: Self‑awareness
strengths.detail: Identifies that the day felt heavy and that irritability surfaced quickly.

strengths.title: Concrete imagery
strengths.detail: Uses vivid metaphors ("running but not moving") to describe internal state.

kpis.talk_balance: Aarav is the sole speaker; no dialogue balance needed.
kpis.self_reference: Aarav reflects on his own feelings without blaming others.
